newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Mt Edon eyes more gold mine drilling.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Mt Edon eyes more gold mine drilling.

text.p: Mount Edon Gold Mines (Aust) Ltd said on Monday feedback from drilling outside the existing pit at its Tarmoola mine in Western Australia could result in stepped up exploration work in the next quarter.

Results from drilling on the southern extension of the Tarmoola orebody so far this year include 14 metres at 21.25 g/t of gold from 156 metres, four metres at 35.13 g/t from 98 metres and 12 metres at 3.21 g/t from 108 metres, Mount Edon said.

The results, which follow encouraging exploration results achieved on the new zone last year, including 18 metres at 9.06 g/t from 88 metres, underscore Tarmoola's resource growth prospects, the company said.
"Drill results so far suggest that we are dealing with new zones which could add to Tarmoola's resource base." it said.
On January 22, Camelot Resources NL and its partner Teck Corp of Canada launched a A$158 million takeover bid for Mount Edon, valuing Mount Edon shares at A$2.15 each.
Mount Edon has labeled the bid "oppotunistic."
